added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs: baseline_suite (revision 0d57012, gate_base.log) reports 1 failed, 17 passed, 1 skipped, failure_id tests/test_reaper_catches_unrecorded_producer.py::test_the_per_test_reaper_signals_a_producer_that_never_wrote_a_seat_record; after_suite (revision 954de5488, gate_head.log) reports 18 passed, 1 skipped, EXIT=0, failure_ids []. The head failure set is empty, so the set difference against the base arm is empty: added_failure_count 0, added_failure_ids []. Noted: the base arm fails on ImportError, not behaviourally (see findings).

findings.text: the gate's base arm carries no behavioural signal: baseline_suite's single failure is an ImportError on `from tests.conftest import per_test_reap_pids` (the helper exists only at head), and the reproducer test test_the_record_reap_leaves_an_unrecorded_producer_alive asserts reapable_watch_pids(tmp_path)==[] which is true at both base and head. So the base arm shows only that the new test cannot run against the unfixed conftest, not that the reaper leaves the producer alive; the actual behavioural red is carried solely by the declared negative control. The manifest's failure_attribution is {} rather than recording the base ImportError, and the baseline_suite failure_id is reported against 'the unfixed reaper' as though it were the defect. Recommend the base arm be a red that exercises the unchanged reaper (the negative control's mutation is exactly that) or that failure_attribution name the import failure.

the autouse per-test fixture now calls per_test_reap_pids(root, tmp_path), whose environ half runs _live_watch_producers() — a scan of every /proc/<pid> reading cmdline and environ — after every test in the whole suite, not only the arming tests. On the shared fleet node, under the high load that produced this defect, that is a host-wide process scan per test. The head gate arm ran 18 tests in 50.78s against the base arm's 19.41s over the same file set, but the base arm fails fast on an import, so the two figures are not a clean A/B; the per-test scan cost should be measured on an unloaded whole-suite run. The scan is correct, only its per-test placement is a cost worth quantifying; scoping it to tests marked arms_watch_producer would remove most of it.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no product symbol gains a call site; the changed symbols (per_test_reap_pids, unrecorded_watch_producers_naming) are test-harness helpers called only from the autouse fixture reap_watch_producers_armed_by_this_test at tests/conftest.py:510 and from the new test at tests/test_reaper_catches_unrecorded_producer.py:125.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 0d57012; 954de5488 adds the two helpers and rewires the fixture in tests/conftest.py (+58/-7), adds the 134-line test file, and adds the 29-line landing fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names three things: (1) reproduce deterministically before repairing, logging the red run; (2) repair so the per-test reap also signals a producer whose own environ names a home under the test's tree, same proof standard, session-end scan unchanged; (3) the new test passes and the seat-record path plus the foreign-home refusal stay covered. All three hold: the reproducer test test_the_record_reap_leaves_an_unrecorded_producer_alive shows reapable_watch_pids(tmp_path)==[] while the stand-in is live; the repair signals by environ-named home and leaves unreadable/other homes alone; the new test passes at head and the record path and refusal are covered by test_the_session_reap_signals_a_pruned_producer.py and test_watch_arming_isolation.py, both in the gate. The gate's base arm, however, is an ImportError rather than a behavioural red (see findings).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the per-test reaper ends a producer that never wrote its seat record; the diff adds unrecorded_watch_producers_naming (live crew watch producers whose own /proc environ names a RECKON_HOME under the test's tmp_path, the same proof standard as _named_config_home: an unreadable environ or any other home is left unsignalled) and per_test_reap_pids (the union with reapable_watch_pids), and the autouse per-test fixture now signals that union. My independent run of the new file at the reviewed head 954de5488 is green (2 passed in 2.00s), and I traced the reported defect's arm: tests/test_a_review_never_runs_in_harness.py:102-104 sets RECKON_PLACEHOLDER to tmp_path/'config', a descendant of tmp_path, so the environ path reaches exactly the pids that failed the session-end scan.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the head gate arm readable 18 passed / 1 skipped EXIT=0 at 954de5488, the base arm 17 passed / 1 failed / 1 skipped EXIT=1 at 0d57012, a declared negative control, measurement_module/measurement_cwd for the base-arm scratch tree, and a declared landing line.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares tests/conftest.py, tests/test_reaper_catches_unrecorded_producer.py, docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/reaper-catches-unrecorded-producer.html and the (empty) figures directory; commit 954de5488 changes exactly the first three.

justifications.durability: the repair is pinned by a committed regression test that arms a record-less stand-in producer and asserts both that per_test_reap_pids reaches it and that the child's own exit is -SIGTERM (exit 15), so a future change that drops the environ path fails a test rather than only the session-end scan. The seat-record path (reapable_watch_pids) and the refusal of a pid whose environ names another home remain covered by test_the_session_reap_signals_a_pruned_producer.py and test_watch_arming_isolation.py, both named in the gate. The cost to weigh: the autouse per-test fixture now runs _live_watch_producers (a scan of every /proc entry, reading cmdline and environ) after every test in the suite, not only arming tests, on a shared login/fleet node.
justifications.evidence: the head arm is readable and independently reproduced: gate_head.log records 18 passed / 1 skipped EXIT=0 at 954de5488, and I re-ran the new file myself green. The declared negative control is genuinely discriminating: restricting per_test_reap_pids to record-listed pids again leaves the stand-in unsignalled and test_the_per_test_reaper_signals_a_producer_that_never_wrote_a_seat_record fails on AssertionError at line 126 (negative_control.log, 1 failed / 1 passed EXIT=1). The base arm is weaker than a behavioural red: baseline_suite's single failure is an ImportError (per_test_reap_pids does not exist at base), and the reproducer test asserts reapable_watch_pids(tmp_path)==[], which is true at base and head alike, so the base arm demonstrates only that the new test cannot import against the unfixed reaper; the behavioural red rests entirely on the negative control, and failure_attribution is left {} rather than recording the base ImportError.
justifications.fit: the environ path mirrors the established idioms — _live_watch_producers, _resolve, and the _named_config_home proof standard in reapable_watch_pids — so a reader meets one standard for 'this run owns the producer', and the helper names and docstrings state the mechanism rather than a plan label. One asymmetry worth stating rather than faulting: the per-test teardown roots the record scan at tmp_path_factory.getbasetemp() but the environ scan at the current test's tmp_path, so an unrecorded producer whose home lies under basetemp but outside any tmp_path is reached only by the session-end scan; that is consistent with homes being created under a test's tmp_path, and the reported case is exactly that shape.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the node goal is that the per-test reaper ends a producer that never wrote its seat record; the diff adds unrecorded_watch_producers_naming (a live crew watch producer whose own /proc environ names a RECKON_HOME under the test's tmp_path, using the record path's proof standard: an unreadable environ or any other home is left unsignalled) and per_test_reap_pids (the union with reapable_watch_pids), and the autouse per-test fixture now signals the union at tests/conftest.py:510. My independent run of tests/test_reaper_catches_unrecorded_producer.py at the reviewed head 954de5488 is green (2 passed in 2.00s), and the reported defect's own arm puts RECKON_HOME at tmp_path/'config' (tests/test_a_review_never_runs_in_harness.py:102-104), a descendant of tmp_path, so the environ path reaches exactly the producers that failed the session-end leaked_watch_producers scan.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit 954de5488 changes exactly the declared paths and nothing else: tests/conftest.py (the two new helpers and the rewired fixture, +58/-7), tests/test_reaper_catches_unrecorded_producer.py (new, 134 lines) and docs/evidence/fragments/one-typesafe-model-picker/reaper-catches-unrecorded-producer.html (29 lines) — 214 insertions, 7 deletions. No product source, no other test file, no plan file and no plan-version/plan-modified meta was touched; the declared figures directory is empty because the done-when names no artifact.
